functionality.rationale: Reconnect and process restart must resume only verified offsets or fail without corrupting destination state.

security.rationale: Resume authorization must bind peer, roles, transfer, manifest, destination, live session, and revocation state.

performance.rationale: Checkpoint frequency, recovery latency, retransmitted bytes, and retained metadata affect transfer throughput.

compatibility.rationale: The versioned resume schema needs an explicit migration and incompatible-state policy.

concurrency.rationale: Checkpointing, acknowledgements, disconnect, cancellation, cleanup, and restart race across storage and session state.

platform.rationale: Atomic metadata persistence and destination identity must behave across supported filesystems and process models.

persistence.rationale: This task defines durable, integrity-protected, bounded resume records and their cleanup.

adr.rationale: Resume introduces a durable persisted schema, migration, retention, and authorization policy.

architecture.rationale: Resume remains within existing session, storage, and transfer boundaries.

roadmap.rationale: XT-039 owns roadmap closure after adapters, UI, and restart evidence.
